name: gptimer
description: gptimer: TIMG0's T0 at 1 MHz (APB_CLK / 80). Stopped at its 1 s alarm, the count the ISR reads is 1000001 (about 1 us from the alarm to the read at 160 MHz; ESP-IDF's README shows 1000002 on its chip); set to 100 and read back; four auto-reloads a second apart, each read 1 after its reload to 0; then four alarms moved 1 s on each time. ESP-IDF's log time counts FreeRTOS's 10 ms ticks.
